name: Alpha Mask
description: Makes parts of the base image see-through based on the brightness of the mask image. Black mask pixels keep the base fully visible, white pixels hide it completely, grays fade it partially and fully transparent mask pixels hide it as well. The mask is read pixel by pixel at the same coordinates as the base, so it should have the same size as the base texture. A set of masks with a growing white area, combined with a variable, gives a dissolve or build-up effect.

fields.description: The location of the mask texture. Can use variables.

name: Overlay
description: Draws a second image on top of the base image, respecting its transparency, like stacking two layers in an image editor. The overlay is read pixel by pixel at the same coordinates as the base, so it should have the same size as the base texture.

fields.description: The location of the overlay texture. Can use variables.
If true, the overlay is only applied where the base already has pixels, so it can never add pixels outside the existing shape.
